description: Enumeration class defining Sparkplug MQTT message types with utility methods for message type parsing, classification, and naming.

classes.name: SparkplugMessageType
classes.description: Enum representing various Sparkplug MQTT message types with methods for type parsing and classification.

methods.name: parseMessageType
methods.description: Parses a string to return the corresponding SparkplugMessageType enum value, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: messageName
methods.description: Returns a string name for the message type, special case for STATE.

methods.name: isState
methods.description: Checks if the message type is STATE.

methods.name: isDeath
methods.description: Checks if the message type indicates a death certificate (DDEATH or NDEATH).

methods.name: isCommand
methods.description: Checks if the message type is a command (DCMD or NCMD).

methods.name: isData
methods.description: Checks if the message type is data (DDATA or NDATA).

methods.name: isBirth
methods.description: Checks if the message type is a birth certificate (DBIRTH or NBIRTH).

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if the message type is a record (DRECORD or NRECORD).

methods.name: isSubscribe
methods.description: Checks if the message type is a subscribe type (command, data, or record).

methods.name: isNode
methods.description: Checks if the message type is a node type (NBIRTH, NCMD, NDATA, NDEATH, NRECORD).

methods.name: isDevice
methods.description: Checks if the message type is a device type (DBIRTH, DDEATH, DDATA, DCMD, DRECORD).
